page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2g.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 4 physical cores and 8 vCPUs via hyperthreading, paired with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance includes 959 GB of bundled local SSD storage and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate that the CPU and memory subsystems generally perform in the lower tiers. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng and Geekbench place the instance in the bottom 25%. Memory read bandwidth is also weak, though large block write bandwidth and Passmark CPU extended instructions achieve average tier results. Redis SET operations perform at an average level of 5.98 million operations per second, while LLM inference speeds for a small 135M model are average but drop to poor for a medium 7B model.

Given the older Intel Xeon architecture and weak-to-average benchmark performance, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency primarily through its bundled 959 GB local SSD storage, which avoids external block storage attachments. The resource profile is best suited for general purpose workloads, basic web serving, Redis caching, and applications requiring moderate local storage capacity without demanding high-intensity compute or memory throughput.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2g.2xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose server powered by a dedicated 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8163 processor. It is configured with 8 vCPUs, 32.0 GB of RAM, and a bundled 959 GB local SSD, operating on a KVM hypervisor with a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Performance benchmarks show weak single-core and multi-core CPU capabilities, placing in the bottom 25% for stress-ng and Geekbench tests. However, it achieves average results in Passmark CPU tests, large block memory writes, and Redis SET operations, which reach 5.98 million operations per second. This instance provides qualitative cost value by integrating local SSD storage directly into the hardware profile. It is suited for general-purpose workloads, basic web serving, and caching applications that require local storage but do not demand high-intensity compute or memory performance.
